verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an on-device iOS terminal client, and its open-source repo documents that users can download, build and install the app themselves through Xcode. A community member confirms you can compile it yourself for free. That is the closest equivalent to self-hosting for this kind of product, but it means building and sideloading a client, not running a hosted service. Missing for 10: documented self-host or deployment guidance beyond building in Xcode, any server-side component to host, and independent hands-on reports of self-built installs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
